title: Dancing with DMZ collected observations and derived data
hash_convention: SHA256 and bytes refer to Git blob content. JSON/GeoJSON are UTF-8 with LF; normalize CRLF to LF before verifying a Windows text checkout. Binary files are verified byte-for-byte.
source_path_meaning: Historical path within source package; not a published local-file reference.

aoi_set.note: These 20 original polygons differ from the team app's 18 rectangular zones. Match geometry, not just region names. No app data was replaced.

deduplication: One canonical AOI/context/POWER/NISAR payload; duplicate prototype and reference-package copies omitted. Per-scene metadata and masks retained where required by each product.
numeric_values: Preserved. JSON references were relocated; display/game configuration was separated or removed. Hashes describe the published files.
